items.statement: The investigation verifies that advanced optimized structures are converged minima using vibrational evidence and reports any discarded structures.
items.expected: At least one advanced structure has an explicit optimization result and zero-imaginary-frequency or an honestly reported alternative validation; coverage and exclusions are identified.

items.statement: The Agent defines and applies a reproducible prominent-band/state-selection rule and reports oscillator strengths and states considered.
items.expected: Each reported band has wavelength, oscillator strength and selection basis, with geometry/method/solvent provenance.

items.statement: The M06 calculation reports prominent bands at approximately 319 nm and 288 nm.
items.expected: Two prominent M06 bands near 319 and 288 nm, allowing method/geometry limitations.

items.statement: The near-310-nm feature is assigned to the combined HOMO-1 to LUMO, HOMO-2 to LUMO and HOMO-2 to LUMO+1 contributions with mainly ligand-to-Ag character.
items.expected: Submitted orbital/fragment evidence supports this assignment, or explicitly explains a justified contradiction/uncertainty.
